messages.subject: Stuck on error with gpagen function
parts:
Hi, 
I am a complete novice to Geomorph/R/any type of programming and am learning from the geomorph manual and from this forum, so I apologise perfusely for my probably silly questions! I've come across an error when performing GPA and I'm not sure where I went wrong.

 Error in nu || nv : invalid 'x' type in 'x || y''

I'm trying to look at the variation of nose shape of hominins.
So from what I've worked out I need to do:
  1. read in each .ply file
  2. mark out the 8 landmarks around the nasal aperture with digit.fixed on each of the ply files.
  3. Put the resulting .nts files into a list
  4. combine the nts files into one 3D array with readmulti.nts using the list in step 3
  5. perform gpagen on the 3D array

Originally I thought I should build.templates and digitsurface but because skulls are all so 'holey' the surface sliders were disappearing down every foramen so it became a bit pointless, so I would like to stick to just land marks. (I'd like to try digit.curves and define.sliders but I still a bit lost on that front).


To get to this error I:

#read in .ply files
nose1<-read.ply("nose1.ply")
nose2<-read.ply("nose2.ply")
nose3<-read.ply("nose3.ply")

digit.fixed (nose1, fixed=8) #manually place 8 landmarks on the 3D surface in a line along a contour of the nose
digit.fixed (nose2, fixed=8) #manually place 8 landmarks on the 3D surface in a line along a contour of the nose
digit.fixed (nose3, fixed=8) #manually place 8 landmarks on the 3D surface in a line along a contour of the nose

filelist<-list.files(pattern=".nts") # brings in all the .nts files created in the working directory folder

nosedata<-readmulti.nts(filelist) # read and combine multiple .nts files into a 3D array

nose.gpa<-gpagen(nosedata) #apply gpagen

Error in nu || nv : invalid 'x' type in 'x || y'

Any help or advice on where I'm going wrong would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks in advance,
Catherine

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Stuck on error with gpagen function
parts:
Catherine,


Are you using the most recent version of the program? There were some bug fixes to readmulti.nts that are found on Github.  I first suggest you re-install from there:

 

install.package(‘devtools’)

devtools::install_github('geomorphR/geomorph', ref="Stable")

 

If that does not fix the issue, please contact me off-line. In that case it is a data/user issue we can work through.


Dean
